title: Guarantee unique run IDs
notes: Implemented generate_run_id(prefix) generating formatted run IDs containing accurate UTC date/time (%Y%m%d-%H%M%S) and random UUID suffix.
Wired CLI run command to use generate_run_id('qa').

Enforced fail-closed behavior on collisions: QAController.initialize() fails closed (FileExistsError) on DB run_id collision, get_run_dir(fail_if_exists=True) fails closed on filesystem directory collision, and WorktreeManager.create_candidate_worktree fails closed if candidate worktree path or candidate branch already exists.
